description:
"The girl my girlfriend had a secret crush on came in as my new roommate!"

Due to problems at work, Sehyun and Sunwoo became a long-distance couple. To fill the void left by Sunwoo and ease the financial burden, Sehyun decides to look for a roommate and finds Jina. While Jina was looking around Sehyun's house, she stops in front of a portrait of Sehyun drawn by Sunwoo. 

Without thinking, she remembers Sunwoo, a schoolmate who drew her during high school, and Jina shows Sehyun an old portrait of herself. Suddenly, Sehyun remembers Sunwoo when he saw Jina's drawing. 

'I only draw for people I like.' 

What will be the relationship between Jina and Sunwoo? Will Sunwoo and Sehyun's love survive the wave called Jina?"

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4291002691)
